response.subject: Firm discovery call booking
response.body:
Hi Robert,

Your firm's work across government and school projects caught my eye.

I'm with TidyCal. We build booking pages that let consultants take discovery calls and paid sessions in one place, with reminders to cut no-shows.

Worth trying on your intake flow?

If you want, reply and I'll share a simple setup you can test.

Best,
